item: 1 Frame: base on skids and press core
spec: Base (one welded piece, about 45 kg): two 60 x 60 x 3 mm tube skids 1.0 m; four 50 x 50 x 3 mm cross tubes welded between the skids with their tops flush; 12 mm base plate 315 x 340 mm; two shaped 10 mm lever bracket plates with a 30 mm rest stop bar under the crank; two 40 mm round tie tubes, 3 mm wall, with 10 mm bolted end tabs; two 10 mm eject posts. Core (one welded piece, about 28 kg): two UPN 80 columns about 0.84 m, webs toward the mold, with 40 mm access holes for the base and upper pins; two 20 x 100 mm base beam plates welded to the column flanges; two 20 mm base pin lugs; two 16 mm column feet. About 73 kg of mild steel in two bolted pieces (EPR-DDR-003)
notes: Indicative: 73 kg at about $1.30/kg plus about $12 of cutting and drilling; welding labor not included

spec: 12 mm plate walls round a 290 x 140 x 200 mm cavity; 16 x 50 mm stiffening belt round the top; two 16 mm side flanges, each drilled and tapped M16 in four places; two 20 mm hinge lugs and two 20 mm latch lugs on the belt ends. No guide strap (the piston is guided by its end skirts). About 30 kg
notes: Indicative: 30 kg at about $1.30/kg plus about $15 for grinding the cavity faces flat and square and about $4 for tapping

item: 3 Lid with ribs, hinge and latch
spec: 20 mm plate 360 x 230 mm with two 20 mm ribs, 70 mm high over the plate, cut long at both ends as ears for the 30 mm hinge pin and the 30 mm latch pin; latch pin with a T-handle; rated for 173 kN block force (EPR-CAL-001). About 27 kg
supplier: Local steel stockist and welder; turned pins from a machine shop
notes: Indicative: 25 kg of steel about $32 plus two turned C45 pins about $6 each

spec: 25 mm plate 288 x 138 mm with two 12 mm end skirts 60 mm deep, on a 60 x 60 mm solid bar with a 37 x 200 mm lost-motion slot. About 13 kg
notes: Indicative: 13 kg of steel about $17 plus about $8 to drill and grind the slot

spec: Four 28 x 70 mm links with round ends, 245 mm between centers; one 24 x 50 mm connecting link with round ends, 420 mm between centers; three 35 mm C45 turned pins with circlips (base and knee 192 mm, upper 128 mm); ten case-hardened steel bushes 35 mm bore, 41 mm outside; four spacer tubes (two 16 mm and two 20 mm long); six grease nipples
supplier: Bearing and power transmission shop; local welder
notes: Indicative: link steel about $26; pins 3 x $10; bushes 10 x $3; spacers about $2; grease nipples about $3

spec: 1.7 m of 2 in schedule 40 steel pipe (60.3 x 3.91 mm) with rubber grips and a 0.5 m T-handle for a second operator; 80 mm hub with two 20 x 50 mm round-ended crank plates (107 mm crank) and a 250 mm socket, on a 40 mm turned shaft in the bracket; 30 mm crank pin 112 mm long; 12 mm locking pin with R-clip through socket and lever
supplier: Local steel stockist and welder; turned shaft and pins from a machine shop
notes: Indicative: pipe about $18; hub; crank and socket steel about $12; shaft about $8; grips about $4; locking pin about $2

item: 7 Eject lever, rest catch and end pawl
spec: Eject seesaw: 60 mm hub on a 30 mm pin between the two eject posts, cranked 20 mm arm with a round nose that pushes on the foot of the push rod (160 mm from the pivot), 250 mm socket for the main lever at 30 degrees. End pawl (+Y side) and rest catch (-Y side): each a 12 mm plate on a 16 mm pivot shaft through a bracket plate, with a release handle outside and a return spring; they catch the crank pin at the end and at the start of the stroke. Rubber sleeve for the rest stop bar
notes: Indicative: 7 kg of steel about $9; pin about $6; two springs about $4; rubber sleeve about $3

spec: 5 mm welded wire mesh in a 700 x 900 mm timber frame with a hinged prop
Two 1 L clear jars with lids; 600 x 40 x 40 mm shrinkage box; three measuring buckets; 10 kg hanging scale with 50 g divisions for weighing each fill; salt for dispersion; laminated test chart
notes: Indicative; field tests only (EPR-DDR-001 item 7); scale changed from 25 kg to 10 kg for the fill tolerance in EPR-CAL-001

spec: 12 mm steel flat bar 340 x 40 mm with two 40 mm legs 292 mm apart inside (longest good block) and a 93 mm notch in the top edge (tallest good block)

Eight M16 x 20 8.8 hex bolts with washers (mold flanges, into tapped holes); eight M12 x 40 8.8 bolts with nuts and washers (column feet); four M12 x 50 8.8 bolts with nuts and washers (tie tabs); four M10 x 30 bolts and four M10 x 50 bolts with 35 mm spacer tubes (guard); circlips; primer and paint
Welding rods, cutting and grinding discs, M16 tap

Expanded metal (about 2 mm strand) on a 20 x 20 x 3 mm angle frame: top and both sides over the crank, connecting link and knee (R12 pinch points); two feet bolted to the base plate and two spacer brackets bolted to each lever bracket plate. About 5.5 kg
